![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To ensure the remapping helper is executed using the exact same Python interpreter that is running the backup/restore script, it is highly recommended to run it via `sys.executable`. This prevents potential environment mismatches or path resolution issues, especially when running in virtual environments or custom host setups.

```suggestion
        remap = run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                REMAP_HELPER,
                "--input",
                str(restored_acl),
                "--source-root",
                DURABLE_ROOT,
                "--target-root",
                str(restored_tree),
                "--output",
                str(remapped_acl),
                "--receipt",
                str(remap_receipt),
            ]
        )
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Using `Accept=yes` configures systemd to spawn a new instance of the ledger broker service for each incoming connection. This means multiple broker processes can run concurrently and attempt to write to the append-only ledger file (`/srv/cie9709/access-ledger/append-only.jsonl`) at the same time. Please ensure that the underlying ledger implementation (`AppendOnlyAccessLedger`) utilizes robust file locking (e.g., `fcntl.flock` or `lockf`) to prevent concurrent write corruption and race conditions on sequence/hash chain generation.
